itens.t: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, securing 56-44 Democratic majority
itens.r: Former Democratic Representative Mary Peltola has defeated two-term Republican Senator Dan Sullivan in Alaska. This crucial victory expands the Democratic Senate majority to 56-44 following the 2026 midterm elections. The hard-fought contest in the traditionally conservative state was the final Senate race to be officially called. The outcome is expected to face legal challenges from Republican circles.
itens.e:
Democrat Mary Peltola has won an Alaska Senate seat, securing a 56-44 Democratic majority in the US Senate, according to Reuters reporting.

This outcome matters as it finalizes the balance of power in the upper chamber, directly affecting the legislative capabilities of the ruling party and the broader political landscape.

One must watch next how this newly solidified majority leverages its numbers to advance key policy priorities in upcoming congressional sessions.

itens.t: Xi and Putin blast Western sanctions ahead of summit meeting with Trump
itens.r: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin strongly condemned Western sanctions during high-level talks ahead of the APEC summit. The two leaders emphasized the need to build a multipolar world order.
itens.e:
Ahead of an upcoming summit meeting with Trump in China, leaders Xi and Putin have publicly blasted Western sanctions, as reported by Reuters.

This rhetoric highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions, directly affecting diplomatic relations between major global powers and shaping the international economic climate.

itens.t: SpaceX successfully completes Starship Flight 15 with historic upper-stage catch
itens.r: SpaceX wrapped up the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket from Starbase, Texas. The mission achieved a major milestone by successfully catching the vehicle's upper stage using the 'Mechazilla' tower arms.
itens.d:
SpaceX has completed the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket from the Starbase facility in South Texas. Lift-off occurred on Friday, November 13, featuring the Super Heavy booster powered by 33 Raptor engines.

While the Super Heavy booster was forced to divert for an off-shore splashdown and explosion, the upper stage successfully completed a 22-hour orbit. It returned to plunge through the atmosphere for a historic first-ever catch by the launch tower at Starbase, marking a major milestone toward making Starship completely reusable.
itens.e:
SpaceX has successfully completed the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket from the Starbase facility in South Texas, featuring a lift-off on Friday, November 13, driven by a Super Heavy booster powered by 33 Raptor engines. Although the booster diverted for an off-shore splashdown and explosion, the upper stage achieved a 22-hour orbit before returning to execute a historic first-ever catch by the launch tower.

This milestone matters profoundly for the aerospace industry and commercial spaceflight economics, directly affecting the future timeline of interplanetary transport. By pushing toward a completely reusable architecture, engineers are tackling the fundamental cost barriers of heavy-lift rocketry.

One risk is that booster reliability issues, evidenced by the off-shore explosion, could require further redesigns. Observers should watch next whether SpaceX can consistently replicate the launch tower catch and safely recover the booster in subsequent tests.

itens.t: RFK Jr. faces fierce backlash after US loses measles-free status for first time in decades
itens.r: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is facing intense criticism from lawmakers following the loss of the United States' measles elimination status. Public health officials point to declining vaccination rates as the primary driver.
itens.d:
Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is facing mounting criticism from Democrats after the United States lost its measles elimination status for the first time in over 25 years. The Pan American Health Organization announced the change amid a resurgence of the contagious virus, which has reached more than 5,400 confirmed cases this year.

Kennedy vowed to stop outbreaks and restore the country's elimination status while continuing to recommend the MMR vaccine. However, several Democrats sharply criticized him, with New York Governor Kathy Hochul accusing him of contributing to declining vaccination rates through years of vaccine skepticism.

The company introduced a computer programming model named MAI Code 2, which matches competitor performance at a fraction of the cost, along with a specialized cybersecurity model.

Mustafa Suleyman, head of AI at Microsoft, stated that the strategy of developing domain-specific technology helps maintain low costs while matching or exceeding industry benchmarks. The tech giant also released new models for image generation and transcription.

itens.t: NASA's Voyager 1 approaches historic light-day milestone in deep interstellar space
itens.r: NASA's pioneering Voyager 1 spacecraft is on the verge of reaching a full light-day of distance from Earth. The milestone highlights decades of unprecedented deep space exploration by the aging probe.
itens.d:
NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is approaching a distance where it will take a full light-day to send a signal from Earth, reaching nearly 16.1 billion miles. NASA plans to celebrate the milestone by asking fans to shine Morse Code signals at the sky.

Voyager 2 will take nearly a decade longer to reach the same milestone due to different trajectory choices made during their 1977 launches. While both missions originally aimed to study Jupiter and Saturn, Voyager 1 made a turn at Saturn to examine its rings and Titan before heading outside the solar system.

itens.r: Startup Reflect Orbital announced plans to deploy space-based mirrors designed to reflect sunlight to Earth after dark. The initiative aims to provide continuous power generation for global solar energy farms.
itens.d:

The California startup recently secured $73.5 million in new funding, bringing its total raise to over $100 million, and received U.S. government approval for a space test.

The company is preparing its first test satellite for launch in the second quarter of 2027. Additionally, Reflect Orbital recently conducted a ground-based test in California using spotlights near Lone Pine to simulate illumination for search and rescue techniques.

itens.t: Pope Leo XIV breaks silence on Peru rosary incident and reveals major cancer surgery
itens.r: Pope Leo XIV humorously addressed an incident where a worshipper's rosary struck his face during a trip to Peru. He also disclosed medical details regarding a previous major surgery for cancer.
itens.d:
Pope Leo XIV spoke about being struck in the face by a rosary thrown by a worshipper in Peru and discussed his recent cancer surgery for the first time. Speaking to reporters on the papal plane returning to Rome, the 71-year-old pontiff confirmed that the lower lobe of his right lung was removed on October 13 after doctors found a cancerous tumor.

Although he is still regaining strength and is not yet at 100 percent, the pope expressed determination to complete the 12-day journey through Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru. He credited his recovery to prayer, medical care, and personal determination.

itens.t: Alleged Guatemalan drug kingpin known as 'The Kraken' captured in California by federal agents
itens.r: U.S. federal authorities successfully arrested Axel Bladimir Montejo Saenz, an alleged international cocaine kingpin. The suspect was apprehended in San Diego following a multi-year multi-agency investigation.
itens.d:
An alleged Guatemalan cocaine kingpin known as "The Kraken" has been captured by federal agents in San Diego. Axel Bladimir Montejo Saenz, 40, is accused of helping run a drug trafficking network connected to narcoterrorist cartels across at least six countries.

During a yearslong investigation, agents seized more than 5,500 kilograms of cocaine and $3.7 million linked to the operation. Montejo Saenz pleaded not guilty in federal court and faces up to life in prison if convicted.

itens.t: ULA Vulcan Centaur rocket suffers first-stage booster anomaly, destroying Amazon internet satellites
itens.r: United Launch Alliance confirmed that a Vulcan Centaur rocket carrying commercial internet satellites failed shortly after liftoff. The anomaly originated in the first-stage booster during ascent.
itens.d:
The failure of a Vulcan Centaur rocket carrying 40 Amazon internet satellites was caused by an anomaly in its first-stage booster, according to United Launch Alliance. The issue occurred shortly after liftoff, resulting in low booster performance and stage separation at a low altitude and velocity.

The two-stage Vulcan Centaur is the successor to the Atlas V and has completed five launches since its debut in January 2024. Previous flights experienced issues with strap-on solid rocket booster nozzles, prompting design improvements and a temporary pause in national-security launches.

itens.d:

O governo avaliou que não possuía votos suficientes para evitar derrotas em pontos alterados pela oposição. Três senadores que haviam votado a favor na semana anterior não compareceram à sessão, gerando incerteza sobre a aprovação da proposta original.

itens.t: Astronomers discover rare class of black holes formed when massive stars failed to explode
itens.r: Gravitational wave detectors have identified a distinct population of black holes originating from massive stellar collapses. Researchers found these objects formed directly without triggering a traditional supernova explosion.
itens.d:
An analysis of gravitational wave data collected by LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA suggests a rare class of black holes may form when massive stars fail to go supernova. Instead of exploding, these massive stars collapse directly into black holes without a traditional explosion.

Researchers point out that many merging black holes detected in the universe share a common mass of about 10 times the sun. This distinct subpopulation provides new insights into the connection between gravitational-wave data and stellar astrophysics.

itens.t: Analysis of SpaceX Starship Flight 15 booster landing and ship catch maneuvers
itens.r: An in-depth technical breakdown examines how SpaceX managed to successfully catch the Starship upper stage while losing the Super Heavy booster during Flight 15.
itens.d:
This analysis covers SpaceX's 15th test flight of the Starship rocket, featuring the launch of Booster 22 and Ship 42 from Starbase, Texas. The video details the minute-by-minute timeline of the mission, examining why Starship had to wait nearly a full day in space.

It also highlights the critical engineering and operational challenges involved in bringing both stages back, including the decision to divert the booster and the historic catch of the ship upper stage by the launch tower.

itens.t: 4K slow-motion footage captures raw audio and visual highlights from Starship Flight 15
itens.r: This video features high-definition slow-motion recordings and authentic launchpad audio from the historic 15th test flight of the SpaceX Starship vehicle.
itens.d:
This video presents 4K slow-motion footage, raw audio, and visual highlights from the 15th test flight of SpaceX's Starship rocket, launched on November 13, 2026, from Starbase, Texas. It captures the ascent from Pad 2 and the subsequent diversion of the Super Heavy Booster 22 after an aborted tower catch.

Additionally, the footage showcases Ship S42 deploying Starlink V3 satellites, spending over 22 hours in space, and returning to the launch site where it was successfully caught by the tower's mechanical arms for the very first time.

itens.t: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes off the coast of Peru, prompting brief regional alert
itens.r: A moderate earthquake measuring 5.9 on the Richter scale struck the Peruvian coastline at a shallow depth. Geological agencies monitored the seismic activity, though no immediate major damage was reported.
itens.d:
Um terremoto de magnitude 5,9 atingiu a costa do Peru na madrugada de quarta-feira, de acordo com o Serviço Sismológico dos Estados Unidos. O abalo foi registrado a uma profundidade de quase 22 quilômetros e foi sentido a 96 quilômetros a oeste de San Juan de Marcona.

O tremor foi classificado como moderado pelo USGS e também reportado pelo Instituto Geofísico del Perú e pelo centro alemão GFZ. Até o momento, não há informações sobre danos materiais, feridos ou mortes decorrentes do evento sísmico.

itens.t: Paralympic School Games commence in São Paulo with record-breaking athlete registration
itens.r: The 2026 School Paralympics officially opened at the Brazilian Paralympic Training Center with a record number of participants. Over two thousand young athletes are slated to compete across multiple adaptive sports disciplines.
itens.d:
As Paralimpíadas Escolares 2026 tiveram início em São Paulo com um recorde de 2.246 atletas inscritos, representando um aumento em relação à edição anterior. A competição ocorre no Centro de Treinamento Paralímpico Brasileiro e no Estádio Olímpico do Ibirapuera, contando com a estreia das modalidades de tiro com arco e paraesgrima.

O evento também registrou um número recorde de mulheres, com 819 estudantes inscritas, o equivalente a 36,5% do total. Organizada pelo Comitê Paralímpico Brasileiro, a competição é dividida em duas etapas realizadas nos meses de novembro.

itens.t: Agribusiness sector drives technological climate solutions with over 800 active Brazilian startups

O setor do agronegócio destaca-se com grande potencial de inovação para reduzir emissões e aumentar a resiliência das lavouras.

Entre as principais áreas de desenvolvimento no campo estão a produção de biogás a partir de resíduos, bioinsumos, captura de carbono no solo e ferramentas de monitoramento climático. A adoção dessas tecnologias é apontada como essencial para manter a produtividade diante de eventos climáticos extremos.

itens.r: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, expressing support for renewed diplomatic efforts and dialogue involving the U.S. and North Korea. The summit focused on easing tensions on the Korean Peninsula.

itens.t: Kogas to expand LNG trading to curb reliance on spot purchases
itens.r: Korea Gas Corp. announced plans to broaden its liquefied natural gas trading operations. The move aims to reduce volatility and reliance on expensive spot market purchases.

itens.t: Main opposition welcomes Daegu mayor's acquittal in martial law case; ruling party calls for appeal
itens.r: South Korea's main opposition party welcomed a court verdict clearing Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho of martial law charges. Meanwhile, the ruling party urged prosecutors to appeal the decision.

itens.t: KBO home run king Kim Do-yeong nabs 1st defensive award
itens.r: Kia Tigers slugger Kim Do-yeong has earned his first-ever defensive award in the Korea Baseball Organization. The home run champion was recognized for his fielding excellence.

itens.t: NASA's Moon Base Plan Is Bigger Than You Think
itens.r: An in-depth look at NASA's ambitious long-term plans for establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon. The initiative encompasses advanced infrastructure and exploration goals.

itens.t: Watch sound bend light as #Starship’s Super Heavy B22 comes back through the atmosphere from space!
itens.r: A stunning tracking shot captures SpaceX's Super Heavy Booster B22 reentering Earth's atmosphere. The visual spectacle showcases extreme shockwaves during descent.
